remarks: Turnkey 3BR/2.1BA luxury townhome available furnished or unfurnished in prime Greenwich location. Features include open floor plan, 10' ceilings on main level, high-end millwork, abundant natural light, oak hardwood floors, and designer finishes throughout. Chef's kitchen with SS appliances, glass-door Viking wine fridge, Viking range, granite countertops, and ample storage. Spacious primary suite with walk-in closet and ensuite bath. Two additional bedrooms, one with Juliette balcony. Private outdoor terrace ideal for relaxing or entertaining. Enjoy easy, upscale living in the heart of Greenwich. Thoughtful finishes and a modern neutral palette create a comfortable, move-in-ready home. Conveniently located near Greenwich Avenue shopping and dining, parks, beaches, Metro-North, and major commuting routes, this home offers an exceptional blend of comfort, convenience, and classic Greenwich lifestyle.
